I replied to Pree in a thread on her #central-random message to confirm I've noted her correction. Her message says the Tansley Parcel signed order form is due 3 April, not the date she posted in #central-team this morning.

She said no action was needed, so I didn't post or change anything anywhere else. I also didn't open #central-team. My reply doesn't repeat the deadline, because a signing date is meant for the account's team and #central-random may include other people. I don't keep notes between conversations, so her original message in #central-team still shows the old date. If others there need the right date, she'll have to correct it herself.
